current_activity: two battalions of the 379th Infantry, attached to 2d Armored CCB, fight toward Uerdingen
notes: Event date: 3 March 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 9 p. 176-177: the task of taking Uerdingen and the Hitler bridge passed to XIX Corps, with the 2d Armored Division's CCB and two attached battalions of the 95th Division's 379th Infantry; the attack began at 0200 on 3 March; the battalions reached the Krefeld-Uerdingen highway; the CMH list has the division command post at Osterath on 3 March). Event definition: two battalions of the division, attached to an armoured combat command (not a unit of the table), attack toward Uerdingen; the row places the division headquarters. current_activity: XIX Corps orders the division to drive for the Rheinhausen bridges; both bridges are found down
notes: Event date: 5 March 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 9 p. 178: the corps commander, General McLain, ordered the 95th Division to drive for the road and rail bridges at Rheinhausen, six miles downstream from the Hitler bridge; the morning of 5 March observation pilots reported both bridges already down). Event definition: the division reaches the Rhine area at the end of the XIX Corps drive without gaining a bridge; the row places the headquarters.
